statements.text: Heterophenomenology, the phenomenology of another, is a third-person method for studying consciousness: interpret subjects’ utterances as speech acts and compose a catalogue of what each subject believes about their conscious experience, a heterophenomenological world. That catalogue, with all data about concurrent brain and environmental events, is the total data set for a theory of human consciousness.

sources.quote: This third-person methodology, dubbed heterophenomenology (phenomenology of another not oneself)
comprise the total data set for a theory of human consciousness
